title: The Night Visions of Zechariah
lead: The eight visions Zechariah saw on the night of 15 February 519 BC (Zechariah 1:8-6:8): the riders among the myrtles, the four horns and craftsmen, the man with the measuring cord, Joshua and the Accuser, the lampstand and olive trees, the flying scroll, the woman in the ephah and the four chariots. An angel explains each.
